# Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Documentation
> Official Oracle Cloud Infrastructure documentation, API references, SDK guides, tutorials, and service-specific product docs.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) provides cloud infrastructure, platform services, AI, databases, observability, security, and developer tooling. This index prioritizes documentation, API references, tutorials, and core service guides useful for LLM-based retrieval.

## Getting Started
- [OCI Documentation Home](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/home.htm): Main entry point for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure product documentation.
- [Get Started with OCI](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/GSG/Concepts/baremetalintro.htm): Introductory overview of OCI core concepts and services.
- [Free Tier](https://www.oracle.com/cloud/free/): Overview of Oracle Cloud Free Tier offerings and account options.
- [Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Training and Certification](https://www.oracle.com/education/oracle-cloud-infrastructure/): Learning resources, courses, and certification paths for OCI.
- [Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Tutorials](https://docs.oracle.com/en/learn/oci.html): Hands-on tutorials for OCI services and common tasks.

## Core Infrastructure
- [Compute](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Compute/home.htm): Documentation for instances, shapes, images, capacity, and instance management.
- [Virtual Cloud Network](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Network/Concepts/overview.htm): Networking concepts, VCNs, subnets, gateways, routing, and connectivity.
- [Block Volume](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Block/Concepts/overview.htm): Persistent block storage volumes, backups, cloning, and performance options.
- [Object Storage](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Object/home.htm): Object and archive storage concepts, buckets, lifecycle, and data access.
- [File Storage](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/File/home.htm): Managed file systems, mount targets, exports, and NFS access.
- [Load Balancer](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Balance/home.htm): Layer 4 and Layer 7 load balancing configuration and operations.
- [DNS](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/DNS/home.htm): DNS zones, records, steering policies, and traffic management.
- [FastConnect](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Network/Concepts/fastconnect.htm): Dedicated private connectivity between OCI and on-premises networks.

## Identity, Security, and Governance
- [Identity and Access Management](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Identity/home.htm): Users, groups, policies, compartments, federation, and tenancy administration.
- [Vault](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/KeyManagement/home.htm): Key management, secrets, encryption keys, and HSM-backed protection.
- [Cloud Guard](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/cloud-guard/home.htm): Security posture management, detectors, responders, and remediation workflows.
- [Security Zones](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/security-zone/home.htm): Enforce security best practices through compartment-level guardrails.
- [Web Application Firewall](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/WAF/home.htm): Protect web applications from common attacks and malicious traffic.
- [Bastion](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Bastion/home.htm): Secure, managed access to private OCI resources without public IPs.
- [Certificates](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/certificates/home.htm): Manage TLS certificates, certificate authorities, and lifecycle operations.
- [Audit](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Audit/home.htm): Track API activity and governance events across OCI resources.

## Databases and Data Services
- [Oracle Database Service](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Database/home.htm): Provisioning and managing Oracle databases on OCI.
- [Autonomous Database](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/autonomous-database-serverless/doc/): Documentation for Autonomous Database Serverless features and administration.
- [Exadata Database Service](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/exadatacloud/index.html): Exadata Database Service deployment, operations, and maintenance guidance.
- [Base Database Service](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/base-database/index.html): VM and bare metal database systems for Oracle Database workloads.
- [MySQL Database Service](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/mysql-database/index.html): Managed MySQL service deployment, administration, and backup operations.
- [HeatWave on OCI](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/mysql-database/doc/heatwave-overview.html): In-memory query acceleration and analytics for MySQL workloads.
- [GoldenGate](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/goldengate/index.html): Real-time data replication and integration service documentation.
- [Data Safe](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/data-safe/index.html): Database security assessment, masking, auditing, and user risk analysis.

## Containers, Kubernetes, and DevOps
- [Container Instances](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/container-instances/home.htm): Run containers without managing servers or Kubernetes clusters.
- [Container Engine for Kubernetes](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/ContEng/home.htm): Managed Kubernetes clusters, node pools, and cluster operations.
- [Registry](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Registry/home.htm): OCI container image registry for storing and distributing images.
- [DevOps](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/devops/home.htm): Build pipelines, deployment pipelines, artifacts, and software delivery automation.
- [Resource Manager](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/ResourceManager/home.htm): Terraform-based infrastructure provisioning and stack management.
- [Functions](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Functions/home.htm): Serverless functions platform based on Fn Project.
- [API Gateway](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/APIGateway/home.htm): Publish, secure, and manage APIs for backend services.
- [Service Mesh](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/service-mesh/home.htm): Traffic management, observability, and security for microservices.

## AI, Analytics, and Integration
- [OCI Generative AI](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/generative-ai/home.htm): Managed generative AI models, endpoints, and inference workflows.
- [OCI AI Services](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/AI/home.htm): Prebuilt AI services for vision, language, speech, and document understanding.
- [Data Science](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/data-science/using/home.htm): Managed notebooks, model training, deployments, and MLOps workflows.
- [Analytics Cloud Documentation](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/paas/analytics-cloud/index.html): Analytics Cloud administration, modeling, visualization, and data preparation.
- [Data Integration](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/data-integration/home.htm): Design and run data pipelines for ingestion and transformation.
- [Streaming](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Streaming/home.htm): Managed Kafka-compatible streaming service for event ingestion.
- [Integration](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/paas/application-integration/index.html): Oracle Integration documentation for application and process integration.
- [Data Flow](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/data-flow/using/home.htm): Serverless Apache Spark processing for large-scale data workloads.

## Observability and Operations
- [Monitoring](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Monitoring/home.htm): Metrics, alarms, queries, and monitoring configuration for OCI resources.
- [Logging](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Logging/home.htm): Centralized log ingestion, search, and management across services.
- [Logging Analytics](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/logging-analytics/index.html): Log analysis, anomaly detection, and operational insights.
- [Events](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Events/home.htm): Event-driven automation using OCI service-generated events.
- [Notifications](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/Notification/home.htm): Publish-subscribe messaging for alerts and application notifications.
- [Operations Insights](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/operations-insights/index.html): Capacity planning and performance analysis for databases and hosts.
- [Application Performance Monitoring](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/application-performance-monitoring/index.html): End-user and application performance monitoring capabilities.
- [OS Management Hub](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/osmh/doc/): Patch, manage, and monitor operating systems at scale.

## APIs, CLI, and SDKs
- [OCI API Reference](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/api/): REST API reference for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services.
- [OCI CLI Documentation](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/cliconcepts.htm): Command line interface installation, configuration, and usage guidance.
- [SDK and Tools Overview](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/sdks.htm): Overview of OCI SDKs, Terraform provider, and developer tools.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/tools/python/latest/): Python SDK reference and usage documentation.
- [Java SDK](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/tools/java/latest/): Java SDK reference and examples for OCI APIs.
- [Go SDK](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/tools/go/latest/): Go SDK reference for building OCI-integrated applications.
- [TypeScript and JavaScript SDK](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/API/SDKDocs/typescriptsdk.htm): JavaScript and TypeScript SDK documentation and setup guidance.
- [Terraform Provider for OCI](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/dev/terraform/home.htm): Terraform provider documentation for provisioning OCI resources.

## Architecture and Best Practices
- [Oracle Architecture Center](https://www.oracle.com/cloud/architecture-and-regions/architecture-center.html): Reference architectures, design patterns, and deployment guidance.
- [Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.oracle.com/en/solutions/oci-best-practices/index.html): Best practices for reliability, security, performance, and operations on OCI.
- [Reference Architectures](https://docs.oracle.com/en/solutions/): Solution playbooks and architecture guidance for OCI workloads.
- [Landing Zones](https://docs.oracle.com/en/solutions/oci-landing-zone/index.html): Guidance for establishing secure, scalable OCI foundations.
- [Disaster Recovery](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/disaster-recovery/index.html): Service documentation for orchestrated disaster recovery planning and execution.
- [High Availability Patterns](https://docs.oracle.com/en/solutions/oci-ha-dr/index.html): Design guidance for highly available and resilient OCI deployments.

## Support, Release Notes, and Community
- [OCI Release Notes](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/releasenotes/changes.htm): Product and service release notes across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
- [Known Issues](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/knownissues/knownissues.htm): Current known issues affecting OCI services and features.
- [Oracle Cloud Customer Connect](https://community.oracle.com/customerconnect/categories/oracle-cloud-infrastructure): Community discussions, product updates, and peer support for OCI.
- [Oracle Help Center](https://www.oracle.com/support/help.html): Support resources, service requests, and Oracle support access points.
- [Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Blog](https://blogs.oracle.com/cloud-infrastructure/): Product announcements, technical articles, and OCI engineering updates.
- [Oracle Developers](https://developer.oracle.com/): Developer-focused resources, code samples, and Oracle platform content.
